title: My Dearest Self With Malice Aforethought
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: College student Eiji Urashima grew up as the son of a notorious serial killer, 'LL', who kidnapped and brutalized young women. He wakes with days missing from his memory, a new girlfriend, a bag of cash and a bloodied bat in his room, just as a new LL-style murder hits the news, and learns he has a violent alternate personality, B1, whose actions he must investigate.
life_message: It suggests that a person can fight to own and face their past rather than be defined by a parent's crimes.
